title: AI Economics Dashboard
methodology: Each card stores a dated public signal, source, scope note and directional interpretation. Values are not normalized into one score.

metrics.label: CAPEX
metrics.scope: Microsoft + Alphabet + Amazon combined plan reported by Reuters; total capex, not an AI-only spending figure.
metrics.interpretation: AI infrastructure demand remains capital intensive; return on invested capital is the next test.

metrics.label: AI 매출
metrics.scope: OpenAI company disclosure; enterprise revenue share, not total AI industry revenue.
metrics.interpretation: Enterprise monetization is becoming a core revenue engine rather than a secondary channel.

metrics.label: HBM
metrics.scope: Company expectation announced with HBM4 mass-production shipment.
metrics.interpretation: HBM remains a high-value bottleneck in the compute stack, with supply mix and yield central to profit conversion.

metrics.label: 전력
metrics.unit: electricity demand growth vs total energy demand growth
metrics.scope: IEA chief comments reported by Reuters; global electricity demand growth relative to overall energy demand.
metrics.interpretation: Power and grid capacity are increasingly part of AI infrastructure economics.

metrics.label: 현금소진
metrics.scope: Financial Times forecast reported by Reuters; forward-looking estimate, not realized cash flow.
metrics.interpretation: Revenue growth alone is insufficient; compute intensity and funding requirements remain core valuation variables.
